SELECT s.shipment_id, s.gateway_id, s.cargo_name, s.departure_location, s.destination_location, s.vehicle_number, s.driver_name, s.status, s.started_at, s.ended_at,
r.temp_min_c as temp_min, r.temp_max_c as temp_max, r.temp_hold_seconds, r.shock_threshold_g
FROM shipments s LEFT JOIN judgement_rules r ON s.rule_id = r.rule_id
WHERE s.shipment_id = #{shipmentId}

SELECT alert_id, logger_id, alert_type AS type, detected_at AS occurred_at, extreme_value, threshold_value
FROM alerts
WHERE shipment_id = #{shipmentId}
ORDER BY detected_at DESC
